name: Document Checks
description:
Use this tool only when DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG in existing_runtime_results.

For a new assessment, this is the first mandatory tool.

It checks document presence, readability, completeness, contradictions,
and document-security issues. Stop if it returns is_terminal=true.

name: Business Validation
description:
Use this tool only when BUSINESS_VALIDATION does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG and DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION is already passed.

It validates the synthetic business identifier, legal name, registration
status, and lookup availability.

name: Identity Validation
description:
Use this tool only when IDENTITY_VALIDATION does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG and the document and business checks have passed.

It establishes who the representative is. It does not establish authority.

name: Authority Validation
description:
Use this tool only when AUTHORITY_VALIDATION does not already have
PASS or PASS_WITH_FLAG and identity has passed.

Do not call it again where an EVID-001 result already resolved
AUTHORITY_VALIDATION.

name: System Data Check
description:
Use this tool only when SYSTEM_DATA_CHECK is the first incomplete
mandatory check and all earlier checks have passed.

It examines Party IDs, duplicate records, account-name conflicts,
existing authority records, and duplicate requests.

name: Financial Check
description:
Use this tool only when FINANCIAL_CHECK is the first incomplete
mandatory check and System Data Check has passed.

Do not invent a policy when a financial rule is TBD.

name: Final Verification
description:
Use this tool only when FINAL_VERIFICATION is the first incomplete
mandatory check and every earlier mandatory check has passed.
